selected_locator_records.title: Input-gradient space particle inference for neural network ensembles
Temporal Heterogeneous Graph Pretraining for Relational Deep Learning
selected_locator_records.saved_takeaway: A very recent heterogeneous predictive framework provides competent typed/temporal baselines and chronological evaluation. Type-specific maps, relation transforms, typed pooling, endpoint adapters and structural initialization/pretraining already coexist. It does not demonstrate a rank-one ensemble or its uncertainty benefit.

selected_locator_records.title: Bayesian Deep Ensembles via the Neural Tangent Kernel
selected_locator_records.saved_takeaway: Adds a random untrainable function delta(x)=J(theta0,x)theta_star to every independently initialized learner, zeroing the auxiliary final-readout parameters. Jacobian-based ensemble construction and matching initial output second moments to classification scale are established.

selected_locator_records.title: Self-Routed Tensor Adapters for Parameter-Efficient Universal Visual Adaptation
selected_locator_records.saved_takeaway: Frozen vision backbone, shared Tucker core/input-output projections, low-rank representation routing to core mixtures, classification and auxiliary domain-routing loss.

selected_locator_records.title: LoRA-Ensemble: Efficient Uncertainty Modelling for Self-Attention Networks
selected_locator_records.saved_takeaway: Frozen transformer base plus private additive low-rank attention factors/classifiers. Pinned standard ViT trainer uses mean CE over flattened member logits, one backward and scaler optimizer step after clipping; evaluation class predictions/NLL average probabilities.

selected_locator_records.title: Mixture models and exploratory analysis in networks
OMoE: Diversifying Mixture of Low-Rank Adaptation by Orthogonal Finetuning
selected_locator_records.saved_takeaway: Per-token Gram-Schmidt across LoRA expert output vectors, with a learned router. It is inter-expert response orthogonalization, not an independent orthogonal frame applied to both graph endpoints before their product. Orthogonal expert diversity is prior; graph adaptation cannot claim that principle. Printed Eq7 removes projections but has no normalization, despite claiming unit Stiefel columns. Do not port its displayed formula as a qualified implementation or inherit an optimality guarantee.

selected_locator_records.title: Generalizing Knowledge Graph Embedding with Universal Orthogonal Parameterization
selected_locator_records.saved_takeaway: GoldE uses quadratic-metric Householder transformations for relation-specific graph link scores; the Euclidean specialization and efficient vector computation already include the normalized nonunit-axis form. Graph-specific norm-preserving endpoint transformations are prior. The proposed one-reflection member frame is a restricted attributed adaptation and not a new orthogonal parameterization.
